# Home dashboard

Put the whole house on one screen. A [poster](/cards/poster-card) gives an entity, the weather, the sun, the wind or the rain one large value, a status badge and a picture of its own; [heading cards](/cards/heading-card) carry the clock, the people and what is playing; a [swipe card](/cards/swipe-card) fits several cards into one cell. Every card runs against a simulated home, so tap, drag and hold them.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Home
      subtitle: "{{ now().strftime('%A, %e %B') }}"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: subtitle
      badge_style: outline
      badge_size: l
      badge_position: inline
      badges:
        - { entity: person.malte, icon: { type: image }, show_name: true, rules: &home [{ state: home, color: green, value: Home }, { state: not_home, color: grey, value: Away }] }
        - { entity: person.sam, icon: { type: image }, show_name: true, rules: *home }
        - { entity: person.kim, show_name: true, rules: *home }
        - { entity: media_player.living_room_speaker, name: Music, icon: mdi:speaker, attribute: media_title, show_name: true, visibility: [{ condition: state, entity: media_player.living_room_speaker, state: playing }] }
        - { entity: group.downstairs_lights, name: Lights on, value: "{{ expand('group.downstairs_lights') | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | list | count }}", show_name: true, color: amber }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: weather.home
          name: Outside
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          kind: sun
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.wind_speed
          name: Wind
          visual: { type: flow, variant: lines }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.rain_rate_roof
          name: Rain
          visual: { type: flow, variant: drops }
          inputs: { wind: sensor.wind_speed, direction: sensor.wind_direction }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          name: Power
          icon: mdi:flash
          color: amber
          kind: trend
          visual: { hours: 12 }
          series:
            - { entity: sensor.power_consumption, name: Home, color: amber }
            - { entity: sensor.heat_pump_power, name: Heat pump, color: deep-orange }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.ev_battery
          name: Car
          kind: car
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: vacuum.robot
          name: Robot
          badges:
            - sensor.robot_current_room
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.dishwasher_status
          name: Dishwasher
          value: "{{ states('sensor.dishwasher_status') | replace('power_off', 'Off') | replace('run', 'Running') | replace('end', 'Done') }}"
          rules:
            - { state: Running, color: green, icon: mdi:dishwasher }
            - { state: Done, color: teal, icon: mdi:dishwasher-alert }
            - { state: "Off", color: grey, icon: mdi:dishwasher-off }
          badges:
            - { entity: sensor.dishwasher_finishes, format: relative, icon: mdi:timer-outline }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: lock.front_door
          name: Front door
          badges:
            - entity: binary_sensor.door_front
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:door-open, value: Open }
                - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:door-closed, value: Closed }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
          name: Kitchen speaker
        - type: custom:tile-group-card-pro
          title: Living room
          icon: mdi:sofa
          layout: table
          vertical_align: bottom
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          tiles:
            - { entity: light.living_room, name: Ceiling }
            - { entity: light.desk_lamp, name: Desk lamp }
            - { entity: sensor.living_room_temperature, name: Temperature, decimals: 1 }
        - type: custom:swipe-card-pro
          per_page: 1
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          cards:
            - type: custom:poster-card-pro
              entity: climate.living_room
              name: Living room
            - type: custom:tile-group-card-pro
              title: Kitchen
              icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife
              layout: table
              vertical_align: bottom
              tiles:
                - { entity: light.kitchen, name: Light }
                - { entity: switch.coffee_machine, name: Coffee machine, color: brown }
                - { entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen, name: Window }
            - type: custom:tile-card-pro
              entity: media_player.living_room_speaker
              name: Living room speaker
            - type: custom:poster-card-pro
              entity: fan.bedroom
              name: Bedroom fan
```
